title: Refactor Interactions to Pure Events
prompt: Interactions are now pure events that happen at a moment instead of a duration. Ticket open and close are separate interactions. Interactions have 'date' instead of 'dates':{created, finished}. Compute semantic codebase diff on ticket close. Migrate all existing tickets and goals.
